name: How to Fish Walkthrough
tagline: An independent walkthrough and reference guide for the How to Fish game.
short_description: Independent How to Fish game walkthrough with step-by-step beginner routes, boss tactics, location guides, creature values, lures, achievements, and original visual guides.
long_description: How to Fish Walkthrough is an independent, player-focused reference site for the How to Fish game. It provides illustrated beginner routes, detailed boss and location walkthroughs, a searchable creature list with values and lure requirements, achievement help, and practical recovery steps for common progression blockers. The site clearly separates the game from general fishing tutorials and maintains version-aware, evidence-backed guides.
